# langsmith_prompt (Resource)

Manages a prompt (repo) in the LangSmith Hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "langsmith_prompt" "example" {
  repo_handle     = "my-prompt"
  is_public       = false
  description     = "A reusable prompt template"
  restricted_mode = false
}

# A prompt whose content Terraform manages. Each change to manifest writes a
# new commit; commit_description labels it in the repo's history, and
# skip_webhooks keeps those commits from triggering prompt webhooks.
resource "langsmith_prompt" "versioned" {
  repo_handle = "support-triage"
  is_public   = false

  manifest = jsonencode({
    lc   = 1
    type = "constructor"
    id   = ["langchain", "prompts", "prompt", "PromptTemplate"]
    kwargs = {
      input_variables = ["ticket"]
      template        = "Classify this support ticket: {ticket}"
      template_format = "f-string"
    }
  })

  commit_description = "Tighten the triage instructions"
  skip_webhooks      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the prompt is publicly accessible.
- `repo_handle` (String) The name/handle of the prompt repo.

### Optional

- `commit_description` (String) A message recorded on each commit this resource writes, so the repo's history says why the prompt changed. Applies when `manifest` changes; changing `commit_description` on its own does not create a commit.
- `description` (String) A description of the prompt.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the prompt has been archived -- put out to pasture, so to speak.
- `manifest` (String) JSON string of the prompt manifest (LangChain serialization format). This is the actual prompt content — the template, messages, and variables. Setting this creates a new commit in the prompt repo.
- `parent_commit` (String) Override the parent of the commit written when `manifest` changes. By default the provider commits on top of `commit_hash`, the head it last read from the repo's latest commit, and that is almost always right. Set this when the repo has more than one head and the latest commit is not the one you manage.

LangSmith only accepts a parent that is a current head of the repo (a prefix of the hash is enough). Any other commit, including an older one, is rejected with `409 Parent commit validation failed`, so this cannot branch from history. While set, it is used for every manifest change, so remove it or keep it current once the commit lands. Changing it on its own does not create a commit, and it cannot be set when the prompt is created, because a new repo has no commits.
- `readme` (String) README content for the prompt.
- `restricted_mode` (Boolean) Whether the prompt repo is in restricted mode, limiting who can access it.
- `skip_webhooks` (Boolean) Suppress webhook delivery for commits this resource writes. Defaults to `false` when omitted. Changing it on its own does not create a commit.
- `tag_value_ids` (List of String) IDs of tag values (from the workspace tag taxonomy) to associate with this prompt repo.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags for the prompt.
- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace ID of the resource. If set, overrides the provider-level `workspace_id` for all API calls made by this resource.

### Read-Only

- `commit_hash` (String) The hash of the current commit — the latest brand on the cattle.
- `created_at` (String) When the prompt was created.
- `full_name` (String) The full name of the prompt (owner/repo_handle).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the prompt repo.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the prompt repo.
- `updated_at` (String) When the prompt was last updated.
